value.syntax: # [doc = " The instrument governing a document, chosen from its envelope and the"] # [doc = " held state alone."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " ```"] # [doc = " use pn_interchange::{"] # [doc = "     dispatch, Coordinate, Envelope, Instrument, NamespaceLabel, Registry, Theory, Version,"] # [doc = " };"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let label = NamespaceLabel::parse(\"com.example\").expect(\"a label\");"] # [doc = " let theory = Theory::parse(r#\"e = {0 => \"com.example\", 1 => [1, 0, uint], 2 => tstr}\"#)"] # [doc = "     .expect(\"an assignable theory\");"] # [doc = " let mut registry = Registry::new();"] # [doc = " registry"] # [doc = "     .acquire(Coordinate::new(label.clone(), 1, 0), theory)"] # [doc = "     .expect(\"the first minor\");"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " let envelope = Envelope::new(label, Version::new(1, 0, 3));"] # [doc = " assert!(matches!("] # [doc = "     dispatch(&registry, &envelope),"] # [doc = "     Instrument::Strict { minor: 0, .. }"] # [doc = " ));"] # [doc = " ```"] # [derive (Debug)] pub enum Instrument < 'r > { # [doc = " The stamp is held: the strict verdict is `d ⊨ R(ℓ, M, m)`."] Strict { # [doc = " The stamped minor, which is the held minor governing."] minor : u64 , # [doc = " The theory held there."] theory : & 'r Theory , } , # [doc = " The stamp outruns the ceiling: the tolerant verdict is"] # [doc = " `d ⊨ Open(R(ℓ, M, m₁))`."] Tolerant { # [doc = " The reader's floor: the ceiling of that major."] floor : u64 , # [doc = " The companion of the theory held at the floor."] companion : & 'r OpenTheory , } , # [doc = " No instrument: the document is rejected whole."] Refused (RejectionCause) , }
